payload.rationale: The document is a sprint retro about shipping the async decision widget, 23-point velocity, and the Zephyr integration as the key unlock. I read the map and doors (Thematic, Documents, People; People returned no group). I expanded the positioning narrative (anti-Slack/async decision platform) because the widget is the product thesis, and the Zephyr unlock and Sprint 4 thesis-proven positions, which sit under the zero-effort capture narrative and the dependencies/integrations area. I also pulled the decision-capture and decisions-evaporate narratives that the widget realizes. I deliberately did not expand the pricing-tier, webhook architecture, or next-sprint context pieces: the document does not touch pricing, architecture, or velocity targets, so they would be reaching. The People door was empty, so no person nodes were surfaced for Tanya.

Since no existing positions were supplied, nothing can be attached or revised, and I propose only a narrative leaf from the supplied structure as its home.

The 23-point velocity is a one-time fact and stays inside the position, not a leaf of its own.
